content.text: Done. Added payment terms support to invoices. `createInvoice` now accepts optional `terms` parameter (NET14, NET30 [default], EOM) and sets `invoice.dueDate` and `invoice.terms`. Added `lastDayOfMonth(date)` and `calculateDueDate(issueDate, terms)` utility functions to src/dates.js. NET14 and NET30 add days to the issue date; EOM sets due date to the last day of the issue date's month. Unknown terms return TERMS_INVALID. Added 7 new tests for date utilities and 6 tests for createInvoice terms handling. All 111 tests pass.
